_comment: Positions ledger for report.py. The trading session maintains it: a buy APPENDS, a sell REMOVES. sleeve = swing|momentum (NO 'legacy' — every position is judged each run with a take-profit / trail / hold / thesis-check action; treat the book as an income / grow-the-balance portfolio). Stops are TRAILING: a winner carries a GTC stop ~15% below its running high, ratcheted UP only and never below entry, so it can only ever be sold for a locked-in gain; underwater names carry NO price stop and are thesis-managed (sell only if the thesis breaks, else cull at the monthly rebalance). Options positions (sleeve:'options') may carry a 'manual_hold_override' field to suspend ONLY the mechanical -50% price stop (see CLAUDE.md HARD RULE 8) — settable/clearable only by a genuinely interactive session with a real, live Ryan turn, never by an automated run (same bar as HARD RULE 9).

Sizing and expectations must assume gaps between runs. Do not promise Ryan coverage this system does not have.
_monitoring_mandate.SILENCE_RULE_READ_THIS_BEFORE_PUSHING: At ~26 runs/day, an un-deduped mandate turns into 26 notifications a day and Ryan stops reading them -- which destroys the mandate's whole purpose. So: notify ONLY on a trigger below FIRING or UN-FIRING, never on routine state. Each position carries a _notify_state that every run OVERWRITES in place. Before pushing, check last_notified_trigger: if the SAME trigger is still the live one and nothing material has changed, DO NOT notify again -- update the timestamp and mark and stay silent. Re-notify only when a DIFFERENT trigger fires, a fired trigger un-fires, or the recommendation itself changes. A position quietly working is not news; the journal and the EOD report already carry it.
_monitoring_mandate.WHAT_A_RECOMMENDATION_MUST_CONTAIN: Never send a bare 'consider selling'.
